title: Five Year Plans In India 12th Five Year Plan
definition: The 12th Five Year Plan (2012–2017) was India's final five-year economic plan, formulated under the Planning Commission, targeting 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth' before the institution was replaced by NITI Aayog.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (targets, growth rates, social sector indices) and Mains GS Paper 3 (inclusive growth, infrastructure financing, regional disparities, and evolution of economic planning in India).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Five Year Plans In India 12th Five Year Plan.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
